title.zh: tigergao1518 的 DSH 插件索引

description.en: Independently maintained forks of DSH plugins. Currently lists dsh-selection-ask, a fork of lzbaclz's selection-quote plugin that adds sidebar conversations inheriting the main thread, read-only session review, and DSH-upgrade compatibility fixes.
description.zh: 独立维护的 DSH 插件分支。目前收录 dsh-selection-ask——lzbaclz 选中引用插件的一个分支，新增继承主会话上下文的侧边栏对话、只读会话复盘，以及 DSH 升级兼容性修复。

title.zh: 选中追问（含侧边栏对话）

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation to quote it into the composer, or open a sidebar session that inherits the whole context without interrupting the main thread. Also adds read-only session review. A fork of lzbaclz/dsh-selection-ask (MIT), maintained independently since upstream stopped updating at v0.1.1.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中文本即可引用进输入框；也可以开一个继承完整上下文的侧边栏会话追问，且绝不打断主线。另加只读的会话复盘。是 lzbaclz/dsh-selection-ask（MIT）的分支，上游停在 v0.1.1 后由本分支独立维护。
